item.title: Car hits house in Sandwich
item.description: SANDWICH – A car reportedly struck a house in Sandwich about 8 PM Friday. The incident happened on Woodridge Road. No serious injuries were reported. National Grid was called to check a possible gas leak and a building inspector was called to check the extent of damage. Further details were not immediately available.
